newsitem.title: USA: Sterling Electronics Q4 shr $0.36 vs $0.42.
newsitem.headline: Sterling Electronics Q4 shr $0.36 vs $0.42.

text.p: Thirteen Weeks Ended Fifty-Two Weeks Ended
NOTES: Full company name is Sterling Electronics Corp.
The company said net income figures included a $400,000 pretax ($0.03 per share) lease commitment provision in the fiscal 1997 periods.
The company said earnings per primary share figures represented the operations and loss on sale of its Phaostron Instruments unit in September 1995.
Earnings per share were restated to reflect 5-percent common stock dividends paid to shareholders of record as of January 11, 1996, and December 9, 1996.
Sterling said its fiscal 1997 revenues included $15.3 million in sales from its Marsh Electronics unit, acquired in November 1996.
